entry.title: New: dsh-plugin-manager
entry.summary: Plugin manager with a rescue center: grouped enable/disable by necessity, multi update sources (npm / dshfind market / GitHub), browser-first downloads with an auto-install folder, P2P fallback, pre-boot self-check and broken-bundle quarantine. Exact install spec: dsh-plugin-manager-pro. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
